titre: Control Test n°3 — English (6th year primary)

exercices.enonce:
Read the text:
Next summer, the Ben Ali family will travel to Djerba. They will go there by car. Djerba is a beautiful island in the south of Tunisia. They will stay in a small hotel near the sea. Every morning, they will eat a healthy breakfast with fruit, bread and milk. In the afternoon, the children will swim and play on the beach. Sami loves oranges and apples, but he does not like sweets. Healthy food gives him energy.

Answer:
1) Where will the family travel next summer? (1 pt)
2) How will they go there? (1 pt)
3) What will they eat for breakfast? (1 pt)
4) Which food does Sami not like? (1 pt)

Complete with: by / on / will / healthy
1) They will travel ...... car.
2) Fruit is a ...... food.
3) The children ...... swim in the sea.
4) They will play ...... the beach.

Put each word in the right group (Food / Transport):
apple - car - bus - bread - train - milk
Food: ......   Transport: ......

Put the words in the right order:
1) to / will / travel / They / Djerba / . 
2) fruit / I / like / . 
3) car / go / by / We / will / .

Writing:
Write 4 sentences about a trip you will make and the healthy food you will eat.

Grammar: means of transport.
Complete with by or on.
1) We go .......... car.
2) I go to school .......... foot.
3) They travel .......... train.
